events.title: Designing Experiences through Glass
events.description:
Join Şişecam for an exploration of how glass design shapes our everyday experiences, influencing not only how we see and appreciate a drink, but also how we perceive its aroma, taste and overall enjoyment. Discover how form, transparency, texture and functionality come together to transform an ordinary object into a carefully considered sensory experience. Through the lens of industrial design and material innovation, this presentation will reveal how thoughtful glass design can elevate everyday rituals, shape consumer perceptions and create meaningful connections between products and people.

events.title: DESIGN KOREA
events.description:
24th DESIGN KOREA: 25 Nov-29 Nov / Coex, Hall B, Seoul

DESIGN KOREA examines the transformation and innovation taking place across Korea’s design industry and serves as Korea’s leading comprehensive design expo, creating new business opportunities by connecting companies, designers, and industries.

Showcasing products, brands, services, AI, mobility, and more, DESIGN KOREA shares innovative design practices and up and coming trends from across a wide range of industries. It also expands the possibilities for new partnerships and market entry through convergence and business networking among large enterprises, SMEs, and specialized design houses.

In 2026, DESIGN KOREA celebrates its 24th edition at COEX, Seoul under the theme . The exhibition looks at contemporary Korean design through four lenses: Code, Log, Typology and AX.

events.title: “Weave a Lamp Shade” Craft Workshop
events.description:
Insight Centre for Design, Technology and Creative Arts, Kochi, India, is organizing a one-day hands-on craft workshop in association with Sargaalaya (Kerala Arts and Crafts Village) on 5 December 2026. Thirty students aged 15 to 20 will learn basic knotting and weaving techniques from traditional artisans. Using coir, yarns and scrap fabric, each participant will weave a lamp shade on a ready cylindrical frame made of cane. The workshop aims to spread awareness of design and craft, to show the importance of creating products, and to introduce young people to design as a career path. It also encourages sustainable making through the reuse of scrap fabric and the use of natural materials.

events.title: Designing innovation ecosystems: Lessons from three transformative campuses
events.description:
As organizations seek to attract talent, accelerate innovation, and create lasting value for their communities, the challenge is not simply designing buildings. It is designing environments that enable people, ideas, and innovation to thrive.

This discussion explores three university projects that translated similar aspirations for innovation into distinct, place-based solutions shaped by unique culture, community context, and organizational goals.

Through an integrated design process, each project aligned strategic priorities, economic opportunities, and community aspirations with adaptable environments designed to foster collaboration, discovery, and long-term growth.

Attendees will gain practical strategies for connecting organizational vision to the physical environment.

events.title: 2027 Urban Creative City-break
events.description:
A unique travel formula: 3 days of inspiration, 10+ exclusive meetings with leading players from the creative industry.

The Urban Creative City-breaks are an extraordinary professional and educational experience. Over the course of three days, the trip offers 10+ meetings with renowned professionals, studio owners and key players in the local creative industry – successful entrepreneurs, designers, publishers, architects, chefs, innovators – who welcome the group into their workplaces and give us an insider’s view of the city.

Insights from Belgium’s Leading Urban Innovators

An immersive Belgian trip that connects us directly with the visionary city makers and innovators redefining the urban landscapes of Brussels and Antwerp. By exploring Brussels’ dynamic intersection of grassroots placemaking and EU-level policy, alongside Antwerp’s bold architectural renewal and circular economy initiatives, we will gain firsthand insights into how these cities are practically tackling modern urban challenges. Sustainable design, community co-creation, and the future of resilient European cities.

Join us for the Urban Creative City-break exclusive experience in Belgium, on February 25-27, 2027.

events.title: Salone del Mobile 2027
events.description:
The 2027 Salone del Mobile is back as the star of the design calendar: the leading international event for the design industry will be held from 13th to 18th April, at Milan’s Rho Fiera fairgrounds. Set up in 1961, the trade fair boasts a wide range of furnishing products, distinguished by their expressive power and their functional, technological and material innovation, devised to enhance the domestic scene. Ingenuity, vision, innovation, sustainable excellence and emotion make up the familiar lexicon of the companies and brands that exhibit at the Salone Internazionale del Mobile, which has now been proved to be increasingly more global, inclusive and in dialogue with the entire creative and productive furnishing system. Each year, the trade fair gives shape to its mission as a laboratory of experimentation and cross-pollination, a place to meet, to interface and create new business opportunities. It is here that prototypes and innovations in terms of furnishings, domestic spaces and lifestyles are presented: bedrooms, living and dining areas, entrance corridors and service areas, outdoor spaces with their furniture and cupboards, upholstereds, tables and chairs set the scene for a narrative that starts with this room, exploring how the way we live is changing and, consequently, home living and furnishing.

Learn more

events.title: German Innovation Awards 2027
events.description:
Show your Innovation!

The German Innovation Awards are the cross-industry innovation awards of the German Design Council. They recognise products, concepts and applications that enable genuine progress, from green tech and digital healthcare to smart everyday solutions and complex high-tech systems.

The German Innovation Awards are open to companies from all industries and sectors of the economy, as well as to non-commercial and governmental organisations from around the world. The German Design Council’s expert committees decide on admission to the competition. An independent, interdisciplinary jury of academics and business leaders then assesses the submitted projects. This procedure ensures the independence and excellence of the Awards.

The Submission phase is open until 5 February 2027.

The Awards Ceremony will take place on 12 May at DRIVE. Volkswagen Group Forum in Berlin, Germany.

Learn more

events.title: World Design Congress Seoul 2027
events.description:
Hosted by WDO Promotional Member Seoul Design Foundation, the World Design Congress 2027 will take place in Seoul (Republic of Korea) from 22–25 September 2027. The four-day event will gather the international design community and thought leaders from business, research and education to explore how design shapes the way we think, make and create change.

Set against the background of Seoul’s iconic Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP), the Congress will include a one-day Research and Education Forum, a two-day international design conference as well as WDO’s 35th General Assembly.
